title: Why it sucks being a KV Mechelen fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Mechelen fan!
It starts when you're six. Your friends support Anderlecht or Club Brugge. You support... Malinwa. Nobody knows what that means.
Age eight. Your dad tells you about 1988. Mechelen beat Ajax. You won a European trophy! He tells you every day. Every. Single. Day.
Age eleven. Relegated. Your dad says: "In 1988, this never happened."
Age twelve. You're in the second division... and you win the Belgian Cup! Against Gent. Sorry, Gent fans. Then you get banned from Europe anyway.
Age fourteen. Your friends ask: "Where is Mechelen?" "Between Brussels and Antwerp." They still don't know.
Age seventeen. Your dad tells the 1988 story again. This time... you won five nil.
That's the thing about being a Mechelen fan. Your best season happened before you were born.
But one day... you'll tell your kids about it too. Every. Single. Day.
Tag a real Malinwa. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
